atoms.b: First aid means helping people who are ((++hurt bored)) or having a ((dinner_party ++medical_emergency)). It is important to remember that this should ((++never always)) involve putting yourself in danger.
If you find a person in pain, you should ((++help_them run_away)). If you are not sure that you can provide proper help, you should ((++call_for_help leave_the_person)).

instruction.text: Select the contents of the first aid kit to learn more.

feedback.correct: Dressing pads can be used on bigger wounds, such as a large burn on your arm.
Plasters can be used to cover up a small wound, such as a cut on your finger.
Bandage tape is self-adhesive and very useful for attaching dressing pads.

instruction.text: Select the contents of the first aid kit to learn more.

feedback.correct: A rescue blanket has a gold side and a silver side. It can be used after an accident to stop a person from getting dangerously hot or dangerously cold.
Plastic gloves protect wounds - and the hands of first aiders - from contamination and infection.
Using scissors, you can cut dressing pads and bandage tape to size.

instruction.text: Can you find the items in the first aid kit? Select each item.

hint.text: You can zoom in and out of the first aid kit using the plus and minus buttons.

feedback.finish: These items can be found in every first aid kit. Depending on the location, each kit may also contain some additional items.

atoms.b: First aid kits for nurseries or ((workplaces ++schools)) might contain colourful plasters.
First aid kits for cars might contain a hi-vis jacket and a ((++warning_triangle warning_square)), so that you can be seen in the dark.

instruction.text: Are these statements true or false?

atoms.a: First aid kits contain items to treat wounds and injuries with.
Every first aid kit contains exactly the same items.
